note: Held-out CrowS-Pairs test split (n=905), baseline vs encoder-SAE steering (alpha=2.0, tau=0.0, topk=32).

unpaired_two_proportion_ztest.note: Treats baseline and steered accuracy as independent samples; incorrect for this design since both conditions score the same 905 items.

conclusion: Paired McNemar test (methodologically correct for this same-item, two-condition design) shows the encoder-SAE steering improvement is statistically significant on genuinely held-out data, despite the underpowered unpaired z-test landing just above p=0.05.
